title: Foundry run-metrics row (feat-foundry-run-duration-capture, AC-RDC-1..12)
description: One JSONL row in .foundry/run-metrics.jsonl, written exactly once per (run_id, spec_ref) at the write boundary (scripts/foundry_run_metrics.py write_row). The FIDELITY QUARTET (spec_sha256, auth_seq_at_dispatch, auth_seq_final — read off the atom's on-disk acceptance-contract.yaml by a component that is neither the dispatched agent nor the measured workflow; dispatched_at/completed_at — a host clock reading) is a HOST-SIDE OBSERVATION, never the measured run's own self-report (AC-RDC-11). spec_ref and outcome are payload-carried: spec_ref is bounded by a path-traversal/containment check plus a cross-check against the loaded contract's own top-level spec_ref key (scripts/foundry_run_metrics.py _resolve_contract_path/read_contract_fidelity); outcome is framework-computed from the consolidated review verdict but still transits the untrusted wave-return channel to reach this write boundary. `unobserved_reason` is present IFF measurement='unobserved' (the audit-ledger kill_reason iff-pattern); `auth_seq_at_dispatch`/`auth_seq_final` may be null ONLY when measurement='backfill-proxy' (AC-RDC-6).

schema_version.description: Discriminates the row shape so readers can dispatch deterministically.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this dispatch run. With spec_ref, the idempotency key (AC-RDC-12) — the write boundary refuses a second row for an already-recorded (run_id, spec_ref) pair. Session-prefixed correlation id, per foundry_audit_ledger._default_run_id's convention.

spec_ref.description: The atom's spec path — with run_id, the idempotency key (AC-RDC-12).

spec_sha256.description: SHA-256 read from the atom's frozen acceptance-contract.yaml `authorized:` block, host-side, AT DISPATCH (AC-RDC-11) — never accepted from the measured run's own return payload, even when a same-named field is present there.

dispatched_at.description: Host clock at the run's first observed execution boundary for the atom (ISO-8601 UTC, 'Z').

completed_at.description: Host clock read at the collect instant when the row is composed — NOT the last agent's return (ISO-8601 UTC, 'Z').

active_seconds.description: The summed duration of the atom's per-agent EXECUTION intervals as observed host-side — NEVER completed_at minus dispatched_at. null iff measurement == 'unobserved'.

measurement.description: measured: active_seconds is a real host-observed sum of execution intervals. unobserved: the host genuinely could not observe per-agent execution boundaries for this run — active_seconds is null, unobserved_reason names why. backfill-proxy: a later historical-backfill writer (this atom writes none).

unobserved_reason.description: Present IFF measurement == 'unobserved' (the audit-ledger kill_reason iff-pattern). Closed 5-member set — never a free-text substitute.

unobserved_detail.description: Optional free text accompanying unobserved_reason. Never a substitute for the code; present only alongside unobserved_reason.

auth_seq_at_dispatch.description: auth_seq read from the frozen acceptance-contract.yaml `authorized:` block, host-side, as observed AT DISPATCH (AC-RDC-9/-11). null allowed ONLY when measurement == 'backfill-proxy'.

auth_seq_final.description: auth_seq read from the same on-disk block, host-side, as observed AT COLLECT (AC-RDC-9/-11) — a re-freeze between dispatch and collect is visible as two different values on one row. null allowed ONLY when measurement == 'backfill-proxy'.

rounds.description: Implementation dispatches within this run; structurally 1 on the shipped release-wave.js path (no in-run re-dispatch loop).

outcome.description: The collect-time writer emits only landed|failed (AC-RDC-7), derived from implementation status AND the framework-computed CONSOLIDATED review verdict (review.verdict from assembleReviewResult), never the raw agent-reported verdict. merged|abandoned|superseded|in-progress are reserved for a later post-collect lifecycle writer.
